description: Ex-Aeronautique navale, served with escadrille 59S at Hyeres. Stood at the entrance to the Base Nature at Frejus for about twenty years until it was craned out on 16 June 2022, badly weathered, and moved to the SDIS Var fire station on the rue des Batteries. The ARDHAN census of February 2025 still lists it on the seafront, which is out of date.
museum_name: Étendard IV et Flamant, Caserne des Batteries, Fréjus

description: Already standing at the SDIS Var fire station on the rue des Batteries when the Etendard IV-M joined it in June 2022. No serial published in the town's account, so tail_number is blank.
